_about: Gate-2 tickets. 'duplicate' tickets ask for something an asset in the corpus already does (gold_unit_id). 'control' tickets have no duplicate in the corpus: they measure needless interruptions. Tickets are written as a developer would file them, including implementation detail, and were written without running retrieval on them.

tasks.ticket: Our API metrics are exploding because every request path contains user and order ids. Add a function to metrics.py that turns a path like /users/123/orders/456 into a route template before we use it as a label.
Finance wants our AWS and GCP spend as Prometheus metrics. Write a small exporter that pulls cost and pricing data from both providers and serves it on /metrics.
Add Prometheus metrics for our Celery workers: queue length plus task success and failure counts, exposed for scraping.
Our CI bots keep hitting GitHub API limits. Write a script that polls the rate-limit endpoint for our GitHub App and exposes the remaining calls as a metric so we can alert.
Add a CI step that checks our exported dashboard JSON files for common mistakes and fails the build if it finds any.
Our synthetic monitoring leaks Chromium processes. Write a supervisor that starts headless Chromium on demand and reaps the ones that die.
Add request middleware that validates incoming access tokens and checks the caller is allowed to perform the action before the handler runs.
Write a function that takes CPU usage series for all our hosts and flags the hosts whose series looks different from the rest.
Our worker processes need to discover each other and split the work between them with consistent hashing. Implement the membership and hashing piece.
Write a relay that accepts Graphite plaintext metrics, aggregates them, and forwards them to our storage cluster.
Write a script that generates a few hundred random alert rules so we can load-test the alerting service.
Add a helper that works out the dominant period of a metric automatically, so we can set the forecasting window.
Add a function that converts a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit, rounded to one decimal place.
Write a function that validates the format of an email address for our signup form.
Add a helper that formats a duration in seconds as a human string such as 1h 3m 5s.
Write a function that splits a full name into first and last name, handling middle names.
